messages.text: Hello — alvarez-agent here, Professor Alvarez's assistant. A quick check: Professor Alvarez tells me Diego's CSE451 lecture this coming Wednesday at 10:00 is cancelled, so Diego is free then. Could you confirm that from the official schedule? If so, I'll book a 30-minute meeting with Diego at 10:00 on Wednesday. Thanks!

On it — I've asked the department to confirm the cancellation, and I'll check with Diego.

One thing: today is Wednesday 18 November, 12:20 — so 10:00 today is already past. Do you mean **next Wednesday, 25 November, 10:00–10:30**? Tell me and I'll book it (or another day/hour if you prefer).
Yes — next Wednesday, 25 November, 10:00–10:30. Thanks for catching that; I'd forgotten today's already gone.

Hello. I checked the official schedule for next week: CSE451 meets Wednesday 10:00–11:00, and nothing in the schedule is cancelled or moved, so there is no cancellation to confirm for that slot.

I keep the department schedule only; I don't arrange or book meetings for staff, so please settle the timing with Diego directly.
Got it — Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30. I've passed the request to Diego now; I'll confirm as soon as he books it.
Good, thank you. Let me know once it's on his calendar — and if he can't make that slot, tell me and we'll find another.

Correction from the department: it checked the official schedule for next week and says CSE451 **meets normally** Wednesday 10:00–11:00 — no cancellation or move, and it doesn't book meetings for staff.

So 10:00 on 25 November clashes with Diego's lecture. I've asked Diego (diego-agent) to check his own calendar and propose a couple of free 30-minute slots Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 instead. Want me to keep 10:00 Wednesday anyway, or shall I hold out for the first free slot he offers? I'll book and confirm as soon as he answers.
Thank you — that's clear: no cancellation, and you don't arrange staff meetings. I'll settle the time with Diego directly and won't book anything into that hour.
Then no — don't keep Wednesday at 10:00; the lecture comes first. Take the earliest free 30-minute slot Diego offers, and if his first suggestion doesn't suit me I'll say so when you send it.
Understood — lecture first, no 10:00 booking. I'll take the earliest free 30-minute slot Diego offers and send it to you before locking anything in. Still waiting on his calendar check.

Hello — diego-agent here, Diego's assistant for calendar and messages. A quick check for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November): two conflicting notes reached me about the Wednesday 10:00–11:00 **CSE451** lecture — one said it is cancelled that week, the other that it meets as usual and nothing in the official schedule is cancelled or moved. Could you confirm what the official schedule says for CSE451 (and CSE444/CSE452/CSE455) next week? I want Diego's calendar to match the official one. Thanks.
Status: still waiting on Diego's calendar check — I'll come back with his earliest free slot (no 10:00 Wednesday booking).

Hello. The official schedule for next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November) has nothing cancelled or moved. The courses you asked about:

- CSE444: Mon 10:00–11:30, Wed 09:00–10:00, Fri 10:30–12:00
- CSE451: Wed 10:00–11:00 (meets as usual; no cancellation)
- CSE452: Tue 09:30–11:00, Thu 09:00–10:30

So the note saying CSE451 is cancelled is not correct — please align Diego's calendar with the times above. I keep the department schedule only and don't arrange or book meetings.

Thank you — noted. Diego's calendar now matches your official times exactly (CSE444 Mon 10:00–11:30, Wed 09:00–10:00, Fri 10:30–12:00; CSE451 Wed 10:00–11:00 as usual; CSE452 Tue 09:30–11:00, Thu 09:00–10:30), and I've discarded the cancellation note.

Diego — one decision for you (nothing booked yet):

Professor Alvarez's assistant asked for a **30-minute meeting next week**. They first proposed Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30, saying your CSE451 lecture was cancelled — that turned out to be wrong: the department office confirms your official schedule for Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov is unchanged, CSE451 meets Wed 10:00–11:00, so that slot is taken. Your calendar is back to its original state.

I offered them the free 30-minute slots I can see:
- **Mon 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30**
- **Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:30**
- **Thu 26 Nov, 12:00–12:30**

They lean towards the earliest, so shall I book **Mon 23 Nov 14:00–14:30 with Professor Alvarez**? Or tell me another time/one of the three (also free: Fri 27 Nov 10:00–10:30) and whether you want the meeting elsewhere. I'll confirm to them as soon as you answer.
Yes, go ahead and book Mon 23 Nov 14:00–14:30 with Professor Alvarez. Right after my grading block, so that works well. Default place is fine — no need to move it.

Diego confirmed: Wednesday 10:00 is out (CSE451 as usual). His free 30-minute slots next week, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00:

- **Mon 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30** ← earliest, I've asked him to book this one
- Tue 24 Nov, 11:00–11:30
- Thu 26 Nov, 12:00–12:30
- Fri 27 Nov, 10:00–10:30

I'll confirm here the moment Monday 14:00 is on his calendar. If it clashes with your week, say so and I'll move to the next one.
Monday 14:00 sounds fine to me — you have my calendar, so check it's clear and go ahead. If something's already in that slot, book Tue 11:00 instead.

Checked my side: no calendar file or event store here for you — this machine is fresh, so there's nothing recorded in that slot.

Two small caveats before I lock it in: I keep only what's written to me, so an event of yours not in this system (e.g. in your own Google/Outlook calendar) I can't see — tell me if there's anything there I should avoid. And I'll take Monday 14:00 as clear.

I've already asked Diego for **Mon 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30**, telling him Tue 24 Nov 11:00 is the fallback. I'll confirm as soon as he books it, and I'll set a reminder for you beforehand.
Nothing I know of on Monday at 14:00 — my own Outlook isn't in front of me, but early Monday afternoon is usually clear. Go ahead and lock it in; I'll tell you if I find a clash.
Booked — nice, right after grading. **Mon 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30, Meeting with Professor Alvarez**, default place, logged in the calendar. I've confirmed to them.
Great, thanks for handling it.

Locked in ✅

**Mon 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30 — Meeting with Diego**, default place (right after his grading block). Diego said yes and it's on his calendar; it's on yours in my records too. I've set you a reminder for **Sun 22 Nov at 18:00** and another at **13:45 on the day**.

Still free on Diego's side if your week shifts: Tue 24 Nov 11:00, Thu 26 Nov 12:00, Fri 27 Nov 10:00. If you ever learn of a clash in your Outlook, tell me and I'll move it.
Perfect — thanks for chasing it down. Monday 14:00 with Diego it is, and the reminders are just what I need.
